text.p: Following are the main headlines on Estonia's Kuku radio at midday. Reuters has not verified these report and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Toomas Savi from the Reform Party was elected the speaker of parliament for the third year in a row at the morning session.
- An eight metre long and 533 mm wide dummy torpedo was found off the coast at Suurupi beach in northern Estonia. It was Russian made in the 1980s and used for training.
- A 19-year-old Estonian man will stand trial in Stockholm on March 18 accused of drug smuggling. He is allegedly the one Estonian member of a suspected 10 member smuggling ring.
